answer: The window charges 25 separate visits, each one billed $12 at the door before it opens, and the ripple is that the fee never comes back. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. One name, one proof, one entry: Girthbound saddle moulder saddle seal enforces it, and a seal saddle moulders renew after mould shop checks is how the check runs. Every beacon is counted once. The tally keeps whisper.
